title: Personal pronouns: free practice
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: Maria is my friend. ___ is from Peru.
items.explanationEs: Maria es una mujer y es el sujeto: she.

items.text: I call my parents every day. I love ___.
items.explanationEs: Después del verbo love va el objeto plural: them.

items.text: Tom and I are friends. ___ are in the same class.
The keys? ___ are on the table.
items.explanationEs: Para varias cosas se usa they: they are on the table.

items.sentence: My car is old, but she is fast.
items.explanationEs: Para cosas se usa it, no she ni he.
Antes del verbo va el pronombre sujeto: He is my teacher.
